gen-fs-zina-gf-science-gothic: Science Gothic cuts every letter at a single depth, with stroke ends set well apart. Science Gothic stays level under Zina, whose broad-nib downstrokes swell fat while its upstrokes thin to threads.
gen-gf-abhaya-libre-fs-bespoke-sans: Bold thicks, hairline thins: that is Abhaya Libre. Bespoke Sans keeps its contrast low and leaves generous space where curves meet the stem, a crisp foil to that weight.
gen-gf-aboreto-roboto-slab: Aboreto sets open-bowled letters far apart under a tall x-height, its downstrokes swelling toward thread-thin upstrokes. Roboto Slab, a precise slab-serif with open throats, gives it a structured footing.
gen-gf-akatab-fs-literata: Open-mouthed curves run through every letter of Akatab, giving it a modern, contemporary lean. Literata then adds sturdy hairlines and slightly heavier strokes, like a flat brush held half-turned.
gen-gf-amaranth-fs-literata: Modern and plain, Amaranth keeps its strokes low in contrast, while Literata moves with a shift you feel more than see. Amaranth earns its keep when set big and short.
gen-gf-anta-fs-literata: Anta never swells or thins a stroke, and its e opens like a wide funnel. Literata, a serif with medium-low stress between stem and hairline, brings a bookish counterpoint.
gen-gf-anybody-instrument-sans: Lowercase packed tight against the caps defines Anybody, whose curve ends flare gently. And Instrument Sans holds one unchanging line weight, its c ends pointing apart like open pincers.
gen-gf-anybody-inter: Bold, flared, and crowding its own caps: that is Anybody. Inter sits beside it as a quiet sans-serif, with big breathing counters and an s whose spine matches its terminals.
gen-gf-anybody-poppins: Distinctive from the first letter, Anybody flares its curve ends gently and packs lowercase up toward the caps. Poppins brings rope-loose curves and a sturdy tall lowercase, with no thick-thin flicker to catch the eye.
gen-gf-arbutus-slab-fs-bespoke-sans: Dignified, with weight that shifts only slightly: that is Arbutus Slab. Bespoke Sans then takes over with low contrast and generous room around its curves, so paragraphs read crisply from line to line.
